headline: Prezident turk kompaniyalarini mamlakatga yanada faol investitsiya kiritishga chorladi
summary: President Mirziyoyev attended the first meeting of the Uzbekistan-Turkey high-level business council and invited Turkish companies to take part in joint projects and privatisation. Turkish Vice President Cevdet Yilmaz attended the event.
why: Foreign direct investment and state privatisation programmes shape capital flows and deal pipelines for investors in Central Asia.
